name: index scan key range order per pass (PR#8718, CBRD-28283): scan_get_index_oidset () reads the key ranges of an IN list (R_KEYLIST) or an OR of ranges (R_RANGELIST) in the values' ascending order, and reverses them at the first open of a pass of a MIN/MAX only scan marked min_max_only_desc_pass (the pass that takes MAX from its first row) -- after duplicate elimination / range merging, over the merged count, skipping a last range with no row in the same call; the skipped descending ORDER BY / GROUP BY reversal stays; each first open decides the order afresh (MIN pass, MAX pass, restored pass)
fakes: Real: scan_get_index_oidset () (static: the seam only unstatics it), check_key_vals () and its std::stable_sort, eliminate_duplicated_keys (), merge_key_ranges (), reverse_key_list (), scan_key_compare (), compare_val_op (), range_to_rop ()/rop_to_range (). scan_regu_key_to_index_key () (seam): the real one's outputs for KEY_RANGE i from the test's list -- an IN list item EQ_NA turned GE_LE with key2 key1's clone (pr_clone_value ()), a BETWEEN GE_LE with key1 > key2 marked NA_NA, num_index_term 1, key1_bound/key2_bound copied; a multi-column index's key a DB_TYPE_MIDXKEY owning a malloc'd buffer (need_clear, as scan_dbvals_to_midxkey () leaves it), a single-column one an INTEGER. btree_prepare_bts ()/btree_range_scan (): one row per integer value (minus a 'no row' set), a call reads every row of the key range in indx_info->use_desc_index's direction into the OID buffer (OID pageid = value) and ends the range (BTREE_END_OF_SCAN: C_vpid/O_vpid NULL, is_scan_started false). domain_key_ranges_element_compare () / pr_midxkey_compare_resolved (): integer comparison of the first column (the comparison XASL generation decides for INTEGER columns; no DESC turn-around, as scan_key_compare () passes dom_is_desc NULL). pr_clear_value (): the real one's NULL/INTEGER/MIDXKEY branches (frees the buffer when need_clear, value NULL, need_clear false), counting the buffers alive. SCAN_ID/INDX_INFO/thread entry calloc'd: S_INDX_SCAN, curr_keyno -1 (scan_start_scan ()), key_vals NULL-made as the XASL unpack leaves them, no key limit (NULL pointers), no covering, no multi range opt, iscan_oid_order off. min_max_only_desc_pass and the turn-around of qexec_intprt_fnc () (use_desc_index and the mark flipped, curr_keyno -1 as S_GO_BACKWARD sets it) are set by the test; the mark is written through SFINAE, so the suite compiles where the member is absent (base).
